checks: All phases skip truth bytes in initial generic hash check.
Oracle verifies primary manifest phase, primary results SHA, same current data manifest SHA, results phase and exact case order before any truth-file hash/read.
Only after these assertions oracle verifies all truth file hashes then opens oracle answers.
Primary remains answer-byte-free; oldtoy run/code bindings preserved in sidecar.
scope: Static control-flow review of latest runner only; no replay of author programs, no formal test decoding. Assertions require ordinary Python execution without -O.
remaining_limit: Toy scores were produced by historical runner version; current static guard validation must not relabel those runs as executed by the new SHA.
